resolution.summary: Implemented hardware-simulator alignment: fixed JAL writeback (SIM-BUG-1), BHLEQ branch support (SIM-BUG-2), J/BZ 12-bit sign extension (SIM-BUG-3), BZ_T/BZ_N opcodes (SIM-BUG-4), M1 case fallthrough + MFHI/MFLO (SIM-BUG-5), stall bubble injection (SIM-BUG-6), peripheral virtual methods + pointer passing, halt detection, meson build system
